description:
Open an account for the owner: the owner gets an 8-digit code by email, and action confirm with that code answers the key once.
Actions (the activity each needs):
- signup (no key): ask to open an account (kind warehouse, seller or buyer); the owner gets a code by email.
- confirm (no key): the email and the 8-digit code; answers the key once.
Send action and its arguments.

address.description: For signup. A warehouse: the street address of its first facility.

company.description: For signup. The business name. Required for a warehouse or a seller; optional for a buyer.

email.description: For every action. The owner’s email; the code goes there.

name: commercebook_account_start
title: Open an account
